headline: India's Nifty Bank Index Reaches All-Time High Driven by Foreign Inflows
summary: The Nifty Bank index surged to a record high as foreign institutional investors increased equity purchases in India. Punjab National Bank led gains among 12 advancing constituents in the index.
why: The Nifty Bank Index measures the performance of the largest capitalised banking stocks listed in India.

impacts.name: Nifty Bank
impacts.why: Strong foreign institutional capital inflows directly drove the benchmark index to new record highs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Foreign institutional inflows sparked an index re-rating that lifted Indian banking equities to record high levels.
